title: Construction factorial screen - cell C1b: power-norm re-adjudicated within instrument (clean anchor + converged trained-head schedule)
question: Within the same fitter, does the signed-square-root + L2 power-norm lift the sealed f6144 codes at matched cost?

registration_notes.N99.2b: AMENDED 14 Aug after C1's sealed run exposed two registration defects: (1) the p=1.0 anchor claimed argmax-invariance under per-row L2 scaling, which is FALSE once an intercept exists, AND the C1 fitter scores the raw codes 0.2195 rather than the sealed fit path's 0.22487 - so the anchor is now the RAW-CODE SAME-FITTER reference (must match within 0.002), and the gate is adjudicated within instrument: best transformed cell >= raw reference + 0.005; (2) the trained-head read collapsed at lr 0.001/8 epochs (0.0032, the known a2 schedule artefact); the schedule is now the a2_head converged cell: lr 0.0003, 16 epochs, seed 201.
registration_notes.N99.4b: The substantive C1 numbers stand: p=0.5 ridge cells 0.2328/0.2332/0.2363 vs raw 0.2195 (same fitter) = +1.68 points at matched cost; ext600 0.2483. C1b re-measures them under the corrected registration.
registration_notes.N99.6: Encode cells C2/C3/C4 remain registered but not dispatched (full-data codes never cached; ~2h per encode).
registration_notes.N99.7: Smoke runs declare _smoke_note and MUST refuse the sealed output directory.

cell_c1.gate_registered: fired if the raw same-fitter reference and the p=1.0 cell differ by more than 0.002, or the best transformed cell < raw reference + 0.005.
cell_c1.consequence_fired: power-normalisation does not lift the sealed codes within instrument; C1 is a scoped negative.
cell_c1.consequence_passed: power-normalisation lifts the sealed codes within instrument; C1 is promoted and C4 (SPM + power-norm) moves up.
